articles.title: Sony Says Free TV On PS5 Is “One Plus One Equaling A Lot More Than Two”
articles.summary: Sony recently launched "Live TV on PS5," an offering that gives all PlayStation 5 owners access to 100+ channels of free ad-supported TV and movies. Keith Le Goy, the chairman of Sony Pictures TV, recently discussed the reasoning behind launching the service and why he believes it represents "one…
body: Speaking to Variety, Le Goy said PS5 already has 40-50 million people who are "incredibly engaged" with gaming, but also love movies and TV shows. Therefore, he said the company saw an opportunity to target these people, who might not otherwise watch linear TV. He said this is a "very hard-to-reach audience," and also one that is "very attractive" to advertisers.

People can watch anything on the Live TV on PS5 platform for free, in exchange for sitting through ads. It works similarly to other free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) services, including Tubi, Roku, and Pluto.
As with most things in life, Live TV on PS5 came about in part to make money, and Le Goy said he believes Sony can achieve big success here, if it executes.

“So if we can give that audience something that they’re going to like in an environment that they are comfortable with, give our channel partners an audience that they are going to be going after and give their advertisers an audience that’s valuable for them," he said. "That is one plus one equaling a lot more than two."

articles.title: Vfor Vendetta: New Trailer Revealed for the 20th Anniversary Re-Release
articles.summary: Warner Bros. Motion Picture Group, Saga Arts, and Fathom Entertainment announced Friday that tickets are now on sale online and at participating box offices for the 20th Anniversary theatrical re-release of V for Vendetta, which will be in theaters nationwide on November 1 and 5, 2026.
body: The news was accompanied by a new trailer for the re-release, which can be viewed below. The trailer features an anniversary-inspired reimagining of Tchaikovsky’s 1812 Overture by Jonathan Snipes of the experimental hip-hop group clipping.
Based on the iconic DC Vertigo graphic novel written by Alan Moore and illustrated by David Lloyd, the 2004 film was directed by James McTeigue and produced by the Wachowskis.

The movie, like the graphic novel, is set in a futuristic totalitarian Britain where a young working class woman named Evey (Natalie Portman) encounters a masked freedom fighter known only as “V” (Hugo Weaving). Stephen Rea and John Hurt also star.
The 20th anniversary screenings will include Freedom Forever, an exclusive featurette where director McTeigue reflects on the making of the film and its relevance twenty years later.

articles.title: Blacksmiths Discover Control Resonant’s Massive Hammer Is Simply Too Much Hammer
articles.summary: The best tool you can own in life is a hammer, and in Control Resonant, fixing Manhattan requires a VERY big one to perform some percussive maintenance. The Aberrant is the melee weapon that you'll wield in battle, and while it can take a variety of forms, it looks especially satisfying to morph it…
body: Ahead of Control Resonant's release next week, the blacksmiths of Man at Arms took a stab at building the Aberrant. In an episode of their YouTube series--and sponsored by Control Resonant developer Remedy Entertainment--the team put together a solid replica, but for the hammerhead itself, they used hollow steel panels and advanced welding techniques to recreate the Aberrant. It's not hard to see why, because having a solid chunk of metal the size of an armchair would make it challenging to work with, let alone wield.

Even with the finished hammer employing a few techniques to keep its overall weight under control, it was still too heavy for even the burliest blacksmith to pick up or even swing around for a few test smashes. For now, it's the world's coolest-looking paperweight.

articles.title: The Resident Evil Movie Is Already Breaking Records
articles.summary: The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger officially releases today, September 18, but like many big movies, it actually debuted the night prior.
body: Experts predict the movie will make between $40 million and $50 million for its first weekend in the US, and now it could go higher, the report said.

The previous record for a first-weekend Thursday-night haul in the Resident Evil series was $1 million for 2016's Resident Evil: The Final Chapter. No other entry in the series eclipsed $1 million for Thursday previews.
Resident Evil's Thursday previews are pacing well ahead of Cregger's last movie, Weapons, which made $5.75 million in previews and went on to earn $43.5 million for its first weekend in the US.

According to Deadline, the Resident Evil movie had a budget of $75 million, but that does not count marketing expenses. Also worth mentioning is that the Thursday numbers for Resident Evil are based on Deadline's "distribution sources," and not official numbers from the studio.

articles.title: Resident Evil (2026) 4K Steelbook Is Up for Preorder
articles.summary: Heads up, horror fans. Zach Cregger’s 2026 movie Resident Evil may have just hit theaters, but the 4K steelbook edition is already up for preorder ( see it at Amazon ). The MSRP is $44.99, and the release date is TBA, presumably depending on how the film does in cinemas around the world.
body: Resident Evil isn’t a typical adaptation of Capcom’s beloved video game franchise. Instead of adapting a story that’s already been told in a game, writer/director Zach Cregger wanted to make a movie that gives audiences the same feeling gamers have when playing the games.

It’s still set in a zombie-infested Raccoon City, but instead of telling the story of Leon, Claire, or co., it follows a medical courier named Bryan, who has a delivery that brings him to the doomed town. What follows is 95 minutes of undead mayhem, splashed with blood, gore, tension, and more than a little humor thrown in for good measure.

That’s about what I would expect from Cregger, who is also the creative driving force behind the exemplary horror movies Barbarian and Weapons, both of which go to very unexpected places. They both also blend horror and comedy in unique and, to my mind, exciting ways.
points: Zach Cregger’s 2026 movie Resident Evil may have just hit theaters, but the 4K steelbook edition is already up for preorder ( see it at Amazon ).
The MSRP is $44.99, and the release date is TBA, presumably depending on how the film does in cinemas around the world.

Joining Rob Mac (who is also a co-showrunner alongside Noah Hawley) are Lizzy Caplan and Steve Buscemi, along with several new faces, including Brendan Gleeson, Jennifer Jason…
body: According to FX, all of those actors will appear in the first season of Far Cry, making for a pretty stacked cast. Leigh earned acclaim for her roles in Hateful Eight and Fargo, Spruell was recently seen in Game of Thrones: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, Demetriou will be a familiar face to anyone who is a fan of Only Murders in the Building, and Linklater's distinctive voice can be heard in Batman: Caped Crusader, where he plays the Dark Knight. Gleeson is also a big name, having recently starred in Spider-Noir and The Banshees of Inisherin, but if we're talking absolute cinema, you'll know him best for his role as Knuckles McGinty in Paddington 2.

Like the games the FX series is adapting, the Far Cry TV series aims to introduce new settings and characters in each season, so you likely won't want to get too attached to any of the actors in the show's first batch of episodes. As for the Far Cry game series, things have been very quiet since 2021, following the release of Far Cry 6. Ubisoft is reportedly working on Far Cry 7, with the IP now falling under the umbrella of Creative House 1 AKA Vantage Studios.

articles.title: Control Resonant Review
articles.summary: Remedy's follow-up to 2019's Control moves to action combat in an open world and tells a more character-focused story with its paranatural edge intact.
body: Control Resonant is centered around Dylan Faden, the brother of the first game's lead Jesse Faden, who backflipped into becoming the director of the Federal Bureau of Control, and it uses his perspective to fill in a lot blanks from the jump. He goes from being Jesse's tortured brother who was the subject of abusive FBC experiments gone awry to a fully formed character with thoughts, feelings, and dark memories he confronts as he tries to salvage whatever life he has left. He's treated as subhuman and initially seen as dangerous with superpowers he can't always control, but still volunteers to be a tool of the FBC with what's effectively a shock collar bolted onto the back of his head.
points: Remedy's follow-up to 2019's Control moves to action combat in an open world and tells a more character-focused story with its paranatural edge intact.

articles.title: Zack Snyder Confirms a Major Detail About His 'Escape From New York' Reboot
articles.summary: Zack Snyder has finally shared the first plot details for his next movie, a remake of John Carpenter’s 1981 schlock classic Escape from New York, and it sounds like Snake Plissken fans should expect a fairly faithful adaptation.
body: In an interview with the YouTube channel Happy Sad Confused, Snyder said, “The approach is… the movie’s going to be set in ’97… from the perspective of 1981. The war between the United States police force and… the criminal elements takes place, I think, July 9th, 1981 – which is the release date of the original movie. And then the rest is pretty much Escape from New York.”

Essentially, it sounds like the remake will attempt to adhere to the original as closely as possible, down to representing its version of the year 1997 “from the perspective of 1981.” Expect retrofuturistic technology and inexplicable shuriken. As for why he wants to stick close to the Carpenter film, Snyder described the movie as “the perfect combination of kitsch and camp… that’s why I love it.”

Snyder confirmed that he is still looking for his Snake Plissken. Interview host Josh Horowitz brought up that Jeffrey Dean Morgan ( The Walking Dead ) had expressed interest in playing Plissken, which Snyder confirmed. When asked if Snake would look like his iconic, eye-patched self, Snyder said: “He’d better, or I’ll walk out!”

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will be "around 200GB" says game director, as he details Sephiroth and Vincent Valentine DLC plans
articles.summary: We're still about six months out from the release of Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, the final part of the FF7 Remake trilogy. But, already, there is a lot of discussion about the size of the game; whether it's all the divisive side activities on offer in the title, or the fact it won't be shipping…
body: In a new interview with VGC, the outspoken director notes that he's "not worried about the scale". He goes on to explain that the reason the game can't ship on disc (or even two discs, like Rebirth did) is because he's expecting the file size to be absolutely massive.

"Things are still getting worked out, but it’s probably going to be around 200GB of game," he says to VGC. "I understand there are a lot of opinions about this topic, but at the end of the day, the fact is we need to overcome the hardware to a certain extent."

Rebirth weighs in at 91GB on Switch 2, 145GB on PS5, 169GB on Xbox Series, and 155GB on PC, so depending on format, Revelation looks set to be up to twice as large as the last game in the series. Woof. The game will also receive two bonus DLC packages post-launch, and these will be similar in size to Remake's Intermission DLC, per Hamaguchi. "It's best to imagine the DLC like what we did with Intermission: digging deeper into the characters of Vincent and Sephiroth. In regard to whether those stories take place in the past or the present, I’m not going to tell you that now, but we’re excited to reveal that."

articles.title: Massive GTA 5 Leak Reveals Cut DLC Plans and Early GTA 6 Assets
articles.summary: Weeks after the steady stream of Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks prior to the game's big extended look on Netflix, Rockstar Games has another leak problem on its hands. This time, a massive amount of data has surfaced from Grand Theft Auto 5, giving people plenty of canceled DLC plans, scrapped assets…
body: Back in 2023, the source code for GTA 5 leaked online. It contained only about four or five GB of data, while the new leaks weigh around 192 GB, according to GTA content creators like TJGM. People have found a huge Liberty City map for GTA 5 DLC that never came to fruition. Liberty City is GTA's version of New York City, and has been featured in several GTA games. Many, like TJGM, are speculating that the Liberty City DLC was canceled for GTA 5 and intended to be used for the upcoming GTA 6, but there's no proof that's the case.

We had known about a scrapped "Agent Trevor" DLC for some time. It would have seen Trevor, one of GTA 5 's protagonists, do his best James Bond impression as a secret agent. Trevor's actor Steven Ogg speculated it was canceled so Rockstar would focus on the cash cow that is GTA Online.

articles.title: Far Cry TV Show Taps Widow’s Bay Actor and More
articles.summary: While video game adaptations are nothing new in television and film, it feels like it has become the hot thing in recent years. Part of that might be due to the overwhelmingly positive reaction to HBO's The Last of Us, at least the first season.
body: As reported by Variety, five new faces have been added to the Far Cry cast. They are Brendan Gleeson ( The Banshees of Inisherin, In Bruges ), Hamish Linklater (from this year's Emmy darling Widow's Bay ), Jennifer Jason Leigh ( The Hateful Eight ), Sam Spruell (from FX's Alien: Earth ), and Jamie Demetriou ( Fleabag, The Roses ). Alongside Buscemi, they'll also join the previously announced Rob McElhenney (credited as Rob Mac) and Lizzy Caplan. Mac will also be a co-creator on the series alongside Noah Hawley, who has become a darling at FX with shows like Legion, Fargo, and Alien: Earth.

The show will be based on Ubisoft's series, which first released in 2004. No official plot details have been shared so far and there is no telling whether it will adapt any of the games or not. What has been confirmed is that Ubisoft and FX hope the show will run for multiple seasons and are planning an anthology format with each season following a different story and cast.

body: And it seems the company is keen to keep this pace up. "We're at the beginning of Nintendo Switch 2," says Nintendo of America COO, Devon Pritchard in an interview with Variety. "This is just beginning and we've already had some really wonderful experiences, both ours and third-party come to the table and I can't wait to see what the system is going to do and what our talented developers will bring to the table."

She goes on to point out that the publisher's success isn't just in hardware and software, but in Nintendo's recently acquired popularity at the box office, too. "We're working with Sony Pictures. We are going to have a movie come out in the end of April," she notes, referring to The Legend of Zelda. "We're very excited about that". No doubt; Nintendo and Illumination earned $1bn from The Super Mario Galaxy Movie at the last count, pulling in a third of that ($372.6m) in the opening weekend alone.

articles.title: Rockstar hasn't said anything about a GTA 6 Online multiplayer mode just yet, but Twitch's CEO reckons it'll land next year
articles.summary: Rockstar has remained very tight-lipped about GTA 6 's multiplayer component, the potential successor to GTA 5 's incredibly popular Grand Theft Auto Online, not yet commenting on whether it will even launch one.
body: But, in an interview with Bloomberg, Twitch CEO Dan Clancy has seemingly revealed GTA 6 multiplayer's launch window. "We spent a lot of time talking with Rockstar about their plans, and also helping them think about how they can engage our creators," he said. "You are going to see this big bump with GTA 6, but then an even bigger one next year when they launch multiplayer."

Here, it's worth noting that GTA 5's GTA Online mode arrived two weeks after the main game launched, but Red Dead Online - the multiplayer mode for Red Dead Redemption 2, and a more recent indicator of how Rockstar handles these staggered rollouts - went live seven months after launch.

The 'next year' referenced by Clancy here is, of course, wonderfully vague. It suggests we could see GTA Online Mk. II (that's a name I'm giving it, not anything official) launch as early as January, some two months after the big single-player release, or as far out as the end of 2027. What's more likely, though, is that we'll see a similar cadence to Red Dead Redemption 2, with GTA Online coming closer to summer than spring.

videos.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation: Second-Take Preview
videos.summary: Two hours in Final Fantasy VII Revelation goes _fast. _I was stunned when the PR rep told us our session was wrapping up; I felt like it had only just gotten underway.
points: Two hours in Final Fantasy VII Revelation goes _fast. _I was stunned when the PR rep told us our session was wrapping up; I felt like it had only just gotten underway.
At least, that’s what I thought until I reflected on everything I’d done: I zoomed around the skies above its open-world map aboard the Highwind airship, revisited some of the earliest areas from…
This game is enormous, and Square Enix set us loose to tackle the preview session however we saw fit, revealing just a glimpse of a journey that’s seemingly even more focused on freedom than its…
The big question is if that freedom will allow me to better handle much of the bloat that really dragged down my experience with Final Fantasy VII Rebirth.
